title: Check formatter options on serialized cached-exception fallbacks
applies_when: A receiver accepts both rich in-process objects and serialized or cached representations, with formatting options implemented only on the rich-object branch. Python logging records may carry exc_info locally but only exc_text after SocketHandler serialization.
lesson: Trace the actual producer's serialization before inventing a receiver fixture. SocketHandler.makePickle caches formatted exception text and clears the unpicklable exc_info tuple in the transmitted dictionary. A receiver that applies exc_info_as_array only inside formatException can therefore return a string for the cached-text route despite passing ordinary exception tests. Exercise makePickle followed by makeLogRecord on self-generated bytes without opening a socket, and assert the resulting JSON value and type. Keep option-off, direct-exception and explicit caller-override controls; compare the same tests against unchanged and modified source across supported encoders. Choose this cheap producer/consumer check before a network deployment when delivery itself is not the disputed behavior.
avoid_when: A transport may deliberately discard or transform fields under a different documented contract; inspect it rather than assuming round-trip identity. Do not normalize caller-supplied overrides indiscriminately or deserialize untrusted pickle bytes. A local makePickle check does not validate network delivery, pickle security, all subclasses, every Python version or performance. The cited sources establish the representation and branch mismatch, not an accepted repair or measured Scout discovery, total-cost or PR-conversion improvement; the broader evidence-choice strategy remains a hypothesis.

evidence.note: Python 3.14.3 SocketHandler.makePickle formats exception text before replacing transmitted exc_info with None and pickling the record dictionary. makePickle itself need not open a connection.

BaseJsonFormatter.format uses formatException for exc_info but copies cached exc_text directly; only formatException applies exc_info_as_array. Source-level mismatch, not a public native-test report or maintainer verdict.
Official length-prefixed record serialization and makeLogRecord receiver route; the security warning limits tests to locally generated trusted pickle data.
